article: Display a simple Windows window using Rust and windows-sys
scope: Compared the complete Japanese source and all twelve translations, Cargo metadata, Win32 class registration and window creation, UTF-16 strings, callback ABI, message-loop initialization/error handling, and external/internal links.
findings: Replaced obsolete winapi 0.3 with windows-sys 0.61 and the specific GDI, LibraryLoader, and WindowsAndMessaging features.
Removed deprecated mem::uninitialized::<MSG>() and now initialize MSG with Default.
Handled null module/window handles, RegisterClassW failure, and GetMessageW error (-1), quit (0), and message (>0) results.
Aligned project metadata and updated all references to current Microsoft and windows-sys documentation.
The Rust sample passed cargo check on Windows without compiler warnings; the GUI was not launched.

post/Rustでシンプルなウィンドウを表示する/index.en.md.summary: Compared the full translation with the Japanese source and updated its Win32 setup, modern Rust bindings, safe message-loop behavior, metadata, and references.

meaning.note: Compared the complete procedural explanation and clarified window creation, message handling, and Windows-only scope.

terminology.note: Reviewed Win32 window class, HWND, message loop, UTF-16, FFI, and localized Windows terminology.

mathematics.note: The article contains no mathematical claims or formulas.

code.note: Compiled with cargo check on Windows against windows-sys 0.61.2; it passed without warnings. The GUI was not launched. Static review covered MSG initialization, GetMessageW return cases, and the GDI stock background brush.

links.note: Replaced the older third-party example with windows-sys API documentation and current Microsoft references for registering a class, creating a window, and processing messages.
